subtitleNullable: OOF + test preds of 9 tabular foundation models, XGBoost and RealMLP
descriptionNullable:
Out-of-fold (OOF) and test predictions for Kaggle Playground Series S6E10 (Predicting Airline Passenger Satisfaction) from 9 tabular foundation models (TFMs) and 2 tuned baselines (XGBoost, RealMLP).

- Every model uses only the 21 raw columns of `train.csv` (no feature engineering).
- Folds: `StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)` on `satisfaction`.
- Discussion [here][1]

[1]: https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/playground-series-s6e10/discussion/746363
